name: Hushh One — Xtreme Super Computing Burst
description: Xtreme Super Computing Burst is what makes 🤫 Private Agent One a supercomputing agent. It is vertically integrated with your device — a native macOS agent (“One Puppy”) reads live memory pressure, unified-memory headroom, and the hardware profile of your Apple-Silicon Mac — so One can place every workload where it finishes best and move it along the compute continuum: run on-device when it fits, and when a job outgrows the Mac, transparently burst it to the right-sized accelerator (GPU today, TPU next) in your OWN cloud, then bring the result home and tear the instance down. No cloud expertise required; your keys are used in-memory and never leave your control. Offered by Hushh (🤫).

byocGcp.name: X-BYOC-Provider
byocGcp.description: The caller supplies their own GCP service-account credential in the request body (byoc). It is used in-memory only and is never persisted by Hushh.

skills.name: Burst a workload to the cloud
skills.description: Decide where a workload should run (on-device vs cloud) and, when it exceeds local capacity, provision an accelerator-backed instance in the caller's GCP project, run the containerized workload, return the result, and tear the instance down.
examples: My Mac is out of memory for this 70B fine-tune — burst it to a GPU.
Run this rendering job where it finishes fastest and bring back the output.
Offload this batch to my GCP project and tear it down when done.

skills.name: Recommend a placement
skills.description: Given a workload's resource estimate and the device profile, return whether it should run on the local Mac (“One Puppy”) or burst to the cloud, with the reason.
examples: Should this job run on my Mac or in the cloud?

skills.name: Estimate cost and match the best hardware
skills.description: Given a workload, recommend the accelerator with the best performance-per-dollar that fits (not the biggest box, not one too small) and an estimated pay-per-second cost in the caller's own cloud — before running. AP2-compatible offer catalog: /.well-known/ap2/offers.json. Customer stories: /customers.
examples: What hardware and roughly what cost for a 70B fine-tune?
Estimate this job before you run it.
